inn._comment_walls: M5 E3 L0: full 4-side perimeter via walls-v2 segments; north face+cap, sides/south cap-only; east gap at [15,3] for the door. Same Interior_Walls_01 tiles the M5 R4 band used (screenshot-verified then).
inn._comment_ambience: M-BEAUTY Task B3: dust motes ship dusk/night-only for now (plan B3 judgment call -- day is the one ambience case explicitly deferred; a future pilot/rollout task decides whether they should also show at day).

entities.observe: A young human, no armor, no weapon, no idea she is the strangest thing in this world. She moves like someone still deciding to be brave. The inn already leans toward her.
entities.friendly_line: Oh - hi! You've got a good face, you know that? Come in, sit down. I'll find you something warm - on the house, probably. Don't tell Lyonette I said that.

dialogue.speaker: Erin
dialogue.text: Welcome to The Wandering Inn! Mind giving that table a wipe?

entities.observe: A human girl playing at composure a size too large for her. Her hands know trays; her chin knows courts. The two have not finished arguing.
entities.friendly_line: Lyonette's chin lifts, then — despite itself — softens. You're kind. People are not, usually, to the help. ...It is a small thing. It is not nothing. Sit where you like; I'll bring something hot.
entities._comment_pool: Content Wave C2: Lyonette's base talk_pool (wounded-pride-thawing, warmth-arc SEED; C4/Q2 grows it post-quest -- spec 2.2/3.Q2). She is the game's ONLY pre-existing QA-covered NPC to gain a pool, so dialogue_walkthrough (the sole script that interacts with her -- twice, once per waking across its two sleeps) was re-pathed to ABSORB the first-talk pool DIALOGUE_LINE at idx 0 (waking 1) and idx 1 (waking 3, chatted_with_lyonette then =1) before opening lyonette_tip, mirroring the S4 pooled-NPC re-path pattern. Zero rng, so seed 9 holds.
talk_pool: Yes, I work here. No, I did not always. That is the whole story, and you may have it for the price of a nod.
The floors are clean because I cleaned them. Twice. Mind where you set your boots.
...You said thank you. To me. Hm. Most don't. — Well. Don't let it go to your head.

dialogue.speaker: Lyonette
dialogue.text: Mind the floors, they're just done.

entities._comment: Onboarding rev O4: RETIRED as the mage trigger. It no longer banks used_magic and grants no class -- [Mage] is now earned from Pisces (learned_magic_from_pisces). Kept as pure flavor: banks read_dusty_scroll (referenced nowhere as a gate) and toasts a hint that magic exists and is learnable from someone who knows it.
entities.toast: Faded arcane script — you can't read a word of it. Whoever penned this knew magic you don't. Someone in the city must.

on_skill_use.toast: [Light] — A steady white orb settles into the lantern's glass.

entities.toast: You carry the laden tray out to the tables.

entities.locked_toast: You don't know your way around a stew pot. Yet.

on_skill_use.toast: [Basic Cooking] — The stew comes out rich and hot.

street._comment: Liscor gate district (consultant design 2026-07-03, grown from the 10x6 street per accepted Floodplains sec.5). Zones: gate plaza W, main street y2-4, market row y1 x10-19, Watch post x21-24, Adventurer's Guild x26-30 (XL anchor), dirt side street x14-15 south, sewer-grate POI (16,11). All goblin encounters migrated to floodplains POI anchors. Row y4 is the clear transit lane.

floor_layers._pick: Main street cobble band, full width (existing street pick, extended)
Gate plaza slab: the goblin_ambush arena's VERIFIED cobble neighborhood, distinct tone from the street band
Guild forecourt slab, same verified neighborhood
P4 wear-edge jitter: broken cobble cells along the band's south lip
South-district square where the side street widens

street._comment_walls: City wall interior-side: full north run (cap+face, same castle picks as the floodplains south wall -- it IS that wall's inside face) + west runs with the gate gap at y=3. Cap-only on verticals, matching the inn's side-wall precedent. East/south edges open: Liscor continues off-map.

decor._comment: M-BEAUTY R2 art fix 3 + torchlit-stone card: same fix as the (13,10) campfire below -- was unlit, read as a second fake sewer_grate near the gate plaza.

M-BEAUTY R2 art fix 1: this building's block is 4 wide (18-21,15-16) with TWO inn_roof pieces (19,15)/(21,15) but the facade below was a single tile at an unaligned x=20 -- neither roof lined up with a wall beneath it (VISUAL-LOG 'roofs misaligned'). Realigned to the guild building's own precedent (26-30,1-3: two roof/facade pairs at matching x, spaced 2 apart) -- one facade directly under each roof.

M-BEAUTY R2 art fix 3 + torchlit-stone card: was unlit street dressing -- the same stone-ring-with-red-center art as sewer_grate's placeholder rock art, so dark/unlit it read as a second fake sewer grate in the south square (VISUAL-LOG). Lighting it (matching the other street/inn campfire anchors' warm palette) both fixes the lookalike confusion (a flickering warm glow reads unmistakably as fire, not a cold iron grate) and gives the gate district a second torch-pool anchor per the mood card brief.

M-BEAUTY R2 art fix 2: cellar_door (entity, street 10,17) rendered freestanding with nothing behind it (VISUAL-LOG). crate_light.json's route walks down column x=13 then x=10 and stops at (10,16) facing down into the door -- moving the door's own cell would desync that script's hardcoded step counts, so per the brief this dresses AROUND the existing cell instead: one facade_plaster tile immediately east of the door, same row (11,17), never a cell the approach path crosses (path only touches x=10 southbound and x=10..13 at y=13), so it reads as the building wall the cellar is set into without the player ever visually overlapping it.

entities.observe: Watch armor, kept. He stands the post properly — weight even, eyes on the gap in the wall. Bored, but the boredom is a discipline, not a lapse.
entities.friendly_line: The guard's mouth twitches toward a smile despite himself. Hah. You seem decent enough. Go on through easy - I'll remember the friendly one.
talk_pool: Gate's clear. Keep it that way and we'll get on fine.
Move along or stand aside. The post is not a meeting spot.
Watch business is Watch business. Yours is likely somewhere else.
Long shift, nothing's happened. That's the shift going well - for the record.

dialogue.speaker: Watch Guard
dialogue.text: Keep the gate clear. And if you're headed out — the road's got goblins on it lately. Watch knows. Watch is dealing with it.

entities._comment: Content Wave C2: Zevara Sunderscale, Drake Watch Captain, just inside the gate below the guard. Cell (2,6) sits BELOW the three gate corridors every street-route walks -- y3 (entry/forecourt), y4 (transit lane), and crate_light's y5 PHASE-D return (left-28 to (2,5)) -- verified against the passing event logs of gate_district_walkthrough/crate_talk/crate_fight/social_loop and crate_light's intended path; she blocks no walked cell. NPCs are NOT in the sim blocked set (WIGame builds blocked_cells from static `blocked`+wall segments only), so she does NOT shift gate_district_walkthrough's blocked_cells:106 assert. sprite `zevara` is a Content Wave C2 PixelLab pixflux gen (armored light-blue Drake Watch officer) -- see sprites.json + VISUAL-LOG.
entities.observe: Oldblood Drake, light scales, a scar down the left of her jaw she's long past explaining. She reads the gate the way a clerk reads a ledger — every figure accounted for, and every one of them a suspect.
entities.friendly_line: Zevara's shoulders come down a fraction. Huh. Civil, and no bribe. You would not believe how short that list is. Go on through. And — thank you. Genuinely.
talk_pool: If you're here to report a crime, the form's on the left. If you're here to commit one, don't. I've had a day.
Ten years running this Watch. Six weeks of leave, total. That's the whole personality, if you were wondering.
Relc's off being enormous at someone. Klbkch is... Klbkch. Somehow the gate still stands. Don't jinx it.

dialogue.speaker: Zevara
dialogue.text: The gate's my problem, so keep it dull and we'll get along fine.

entities._comment: Content Wave C2: Olesm Swifttail, Drake [Tactician]/council clerk, at the Guild frontage. Cell (29,3) is tucked by the Guild building, clear of gate_district_walkthrough's forecourt cells (25,4)/(25,5)/(26,5)/(27,5)/(27,4)/(27,3) and of crate_light's y5 pisces approach -- verified off every street-route path, and NPCs are excluded from the blocked_cells count. sprite `olesm` is a Content Wave C2 PixelLab pixflux gen (slim sky-blue Drake holding a rolled map) -- see sprites.json + VISUAL-LOG.
entities.observe: Thin, sky-blue scales, ink drying on three of his claws. A chess board waits at his elbow mid-game — played against himself, to feel how the other side thinks. His eyes are a wild, lovely blue, patterned like rain caught falling.
entities.friendly_line: Olesm brightens like a lamp. Oh — a friendly face. Most people's eyes glaze when I mention troop dispersal. Yours didn't. Would you — that is — care to see the board sometime? No pressure. A little pressure.
talk_pool: Do you play chess? No? A pity. I've a board set and no worthy opponent since — well. That's a long story involving a human and a great deal of humbling.
Three reports due by dusk and two clerks who can't count past a company. I'll manage. I always manage.
Supply lines, sightlines, morale — a city is only a very slow battle, and Liscor has been winning it for centuries. I intend to keep the streak.

dialogue.speaker: Olesm
dialogue.text: One moment — three columns into a tally. Say hello properly and I'll lose my place gladly.

entities.observe: A Watchman making the paperwork look like the hard part on purpose. Still — his stance says he would rather a fight than the forms, and could win one.

dialogue.speaker: Watch Guard
dialogue.text: Watch post. Lost property, complaints, goblin sightings. In that order of how much I care.

entities.observe: Silverfang goods laid out with a trap's care: cheapest at the front, the good stock where a browsing hand drifts. A note warns that the seller remembers faces.
entities.toast: Silverfang goods, honest prices. The Gnoll shopkeeper is off haggling elsewhere — a sign says she remembers faces, and debts.
The Guild hall is packed with adventurers arguing over a bounty board. Selys handles the counter work outside today.

entities.observe: A Drake behind a counter she clearly wishes were taller. Tired, sharp, quick with a ledger — she has sized up a hundred adventurers today and found most of them wanting.
entities.friendly_line: ...Huh. You're actually pleasant. That's rare on this side of the counter. Fine - your paperwork jumps the line today. Don't make it weird.
talk_pool: Guild's the usual mess. Bounties on the board, arguments over the board, somebody bleeding near the board.
Need something stamped, filed, or explained slowly? That is the job. Mostly the slow part.
Try not to die out there. It is a mountain of paperwork when you do, and guess who is the mountain.
New face. You'll fit right in - everyone here is chasing coin they have not earned yet.

entities._comment: Onboarding rev O4: Pisces Jealnv (Human [Necromancer], canon -- Horns of Hammerad). Guild frontage (30,4), east of guild_door (28,3), clear of gate_district_walkthrough's forecourt approach cells (27,3/27,4/27,5/26,5/25,5). Track B1 (2026-07-06): bespoke PixelLab sprite (hooded young human in immaculate white robes with faded trim + sash), replacing the earlier citizen_f cool-white-tint stand-in. Teaches magic via the pisces_magic graph; mage.gained_by keys to its learned_magic_from_pisces bank.
entities.observe: Thin, immaculate, hungry in a way food will not fix. He holds himself like a duelist and watches hands, not faces. Whatever he studies, it is not small.
entities.friendly_line: A sniff - though a fractionally warmer one. You are... tolerable company. Rarer praise than you comprehend. I shall permit you to remain within conversational range.
talk_pool: You linger. Either you have a question of substance or you are another gawker. I shall assume the former. Generously.
Magic is not the wand-waving the market storytellers sell. It is discipline. Precision. Neither, I observe, is common here.
Yes, a [Necromancer]. No, I will not apologize for a competence others lack the wit to appreciate.
A thin sniff. Do continue standing there. I find the silence rather more edifying than most conversation.

dialogue.speaker: Pisces
dialogue.text: Yes, I am a [Necromancer]. No, I did not raise anything in this square. Move along, or ask me something worth my time.

entities.observe: Rust holds the bars, not a lock. The draft is steady — a tunnel, not a pit — and the skittering keeps its distance. Something down there has learned to avoid shadows.
entities.toast: A heavy iron grate, rusted shut. Cold air rises from below, and something in the dark skitters away from your shadow.
entities._comment_door_when: Content Wave C1 grate-gate seam. Until `heard_about_cisterns` is banked (C3 banks it from Olesm), door_when's gate is UNMET and interact falls through to the on_interact_accomplishment branch above -- BYTE-IDENTICAL to the pre-quest behavior asserted by gate_district_walkthrough (heard_the_sewers + the exact toast). Once banked, the same interact hauls the grate open and descends: emits the `open_toast`, then transitions to the sewers landing. See wi_game.gd interact()'s prop branch + `_door_gate_met`.

door_when.open_toast: You set your shoulder to the grate. The rust gives with a shriek, and cold air breathes up out of the dark. Down you go.

entities.observe: A Gnoll with a merchant's smile and a soldier's eyes. She prices you the moment you approach, and remembers the number.
entities.friendly_line: Hrr. You have a warm way about you, and warmth I can trade with. Come - for you, I will call it a fair price, and I will mean it. This is not nothing, from me.
talk_pool: Hrr. You look, you do not buy. This is fine. Looking is its own kind of respect.
Silverfang goods - fair weight, fair price. I do not haggle down, and I do not forget a face.
You carry yourself better than before. Good. A city notices such things, even when its people pretend not to.
Speak plainly with me and we get along well. The other kind of talk, I have no patience for.

dialogue.speaker: Krshia
dialogue.text: Hrr. Busy, yes? Come back when you can talk.

entities.observe: A plain door with dark behind it. The dust on the sill is scuffed one way — something was dragged in, and not dragged out.

on_skill_use.toast: [Light] — The orb drifts down the stairs. There: Krshia's crate, dragged behind a broken shelf.

entities.observe: Stripes on the sleeve, ink on the fingers. He would send the crate problem down the chain if the chain had not already sent it back up to him.

floodplains._comment: World environment (consultant design 2026-07-03 + controller integration). Reachable via the walkable inn_door route (M-FP Q1 door-retarget: inn_door -> floodplains (7,6); floodplains_peek was retired once this route landed, see CLAUDE.md). POI anchors: fishing-pond (13,18) [consultant's (12,18) was inside the pond blocking row], ruin-stones interact (31,7). Onboarding rev Task O2 (spec §3): `goblin_encounter_1` relocated from (21,12) to (30,23) with `trigger_radius: 2` -- the wall `segments` at y=25 block every column except x=31 (`liscor_gate`'s own cell), so (31,24) is the UNIQUE open cell from which the gate can be reached/interacted -- and (31,24) sits inside the 5x5 Chebyshev-2 square around (30,23) (x:[28,32], y:[21,25]). Any 4-directional path from outside that square to (31,24) (which lies inside it) must enter the square before arriving, so no route to `liscor_gate` avoids the ambush -- see the O2 report's BFS proof. `goblin_encounter_2` (28,18) and `chieftains_raid` (31,7) are unaffected (interact-only, no trigger_radius) and sit well outside this zone.
floodplains._comment_walls: Liscor wall SE margin (castle picks, iterate) + flood pond as water segments (cap [1,7] = still-water pick from controller grid of Water_tiles; consultant guess [3,3] was island rim).

decor._comment: Relc's fire — moved beside him (12,13) per pilot verdict: it must READ as his.

scatter._comment: M-BEAUTY Task B3: sway tagged on the whole spec (not split by sprite id) to avoid re-seeding the scatter presence hash, which would move WHICH cells host which prop and break the day-shot 'all else identical' contract -- the pebble instances in this mixed pool also get the shader at the shared subtle default amplitude, imperceptible in practice (see world.gd's _build_scatter comment / task-b3-report.md).

floodplains._comment_ambience: M-BEAUTY Task B3: fireflies + pond_glints share the same rect -- a bounding box over the pond's water-segment cells (walls.segments rows y=17-21, x=7-13, see the walls block above) plus one cell of margin so fireflies read as hovering around/above the water, not clipped to exactly the water tiles.

entities.observe: A Drake built like a barracks door, spear worn smooth from use, standing at ease the way only dangerous people stand. He watches the road and everyone on it — including you, now.
entities.friendly_line: Heh. Alright, alright - I like you. You've got the look of someone who buys a guy a drink after. We're good, you and me. Best guardsman in Liscor says so.

entities.observe: Straw and burlap lashed to posts, hacked half to ribbons. Someone drills here often, and hard. The stitching tells you where a real guard would break.

sewers._comment: Content Wave C1: the Liscor sewers (~20x14, cave biome). Entered from the street `sewer_grate` prop once `heard_about_cisterns` is banked (C3 banks it from Olesm) -- see the door_when seam on that prop + wi_game.gd's prop-interact branch. Water channels are walls.segments on the free_pack Water_tiles sheet, so world.gd's `_build_water_shimmer` paints the shimmer overlay automatically (sheet-match) AND they block movement (segment_cells joins the sim blocked set). Left (x0-2) and right (x17-19) walkways cross the two channels. Dark mood pin lives in data/moods.json; lights glow at dusk/night (light_energy_by_phase day=0.0), while the always-on pond_glints/dust ambience carries the day-phase atmosphere.

floor_layers._pick: cave-floor variation reusing the cave biome's verified floor-tile neighborhood.

segments._comment: Water channel A (upper). Water_tiles sheet -> auto shimmer overlay + blocking.

entities._comment: The way back up. Returns to the street beside the sewer_grate (15,11); the grate is the sole street<->sewers link, so exit lands at the grate regardless.

entities.observe: Pale green moss crusts the old brick in patches, breathing a cold light that never quite reaches the water. Drakes farmed it once, they say, to see down here without lanterns.
entities.toast: Phosphor moss clings to the brick, glowing a sick, cold green. Cool to the touch, and it hisses faintly when your shadow crosses it.

entities.observe: A carved stone boundary marker, Drake glyphs worn shallow. It counts cisterns and sluice-gates in a hand two centuries dead. Someone scratched a newer mark beside it: a spider, hastily.
entities.toast: An old Drake drainage marker, its glyphs half-swallowed by grime. You can just make out a map of channels — and a fresh scratch, shaped like a spider, gouged over the third cistern.

entities.observe: A market crate, swollen and burst, washed down through a grate above. Whatever was in it fed something down here long ago.
entities.toast: A ruined crate, half-sunk in silt. Merchant stamps still show under the rot — lost cargo, swallowed by the sewers and picked clean.

entities.observe: Cable-thick silk, black-and-silver banded, stretched wall to wall. Not a house spider's work. Something with a shield on its back spun this, and recently.
entities.toast: Ropes of banded silk choke the side passage, strong as wire. Wrapped in it, drained pale: a rat, a boot, something that used to be a Watchman's lantern.

entities._comment: The sewers' easy trash fight -- the sewers_walkthrough clears it (autoplay). Interact-only (no trigger_radius) so QA controls when it starts.

The Shield Spider nest -- Quest 1 'Something in the Cisterns' FIGHT path (C3 wires the quest; on_victory banks cleared_the_nest for C3 to read). Interact-only (no trigger_radius) so C3's SKILL path can [Observe] the nest without triggering combat.
entities.observe: Two of them, banded carapaces catching the moss-light, waiting where the silk is thickest. Their legs test the air toward you. Behind them the tunnel drops away — and more eyes catch the light down there than you want to count.
